context: Make an explicit architecture decision for raw provenance versus canonical comparison identity. Preserve original benchmark slug and test_type for evidence, introduce centrally generated canonical family/phase fields only where equivalence is justified, and recompute rankings from those fields. Where equivalence cannot be proven, retain separate cohorts and explain them. Tie public positioning to a machine-checkable coverage summary: a curated-preview label may ship with narrow data; a general leaderboard claim requires an agreed breadth threshold.
description: The real curated snapshot has 207 results but only 15 ranking-eligible rows across seven stored cohorts, three stored benchmark slugs, two human benchmark families, and scale factors no larger than 0.1. SSB is split between ssb and star_schema, while TPC-H contains standard and power phases. The hosted-results contract treats phase mismatch as a warning, but the Explorer cohort key and Compare UI treat phase as identity. Resolve those semantic contradictions before making a broad Database Leaderboards claim.

anti_patterns.dont: merge phases solely to increase leaderboard density
anti_patterns.instead: require documented query-set and execution-semantic equivalence before aggregation
anti_patterns.why: power, throughput, standard, and vendor-specific phases may measure different workloads

anti_patterns.dont: rewrite raw ssb/star_schema or standard/power provenance in place
anti_patterns.instead: add a derived canonical identity beside immutable raw fields
anti_patterns.why: the original evidence vocabulary is needed to audit historical results

anti_patterns.dont: solve narrow coverage only by changing marketing copy
anti_patterns.instead: fix the contract and use honest copy as a separate launch-positioning control
anti_patterns.why: identity fragmentation would continue to distort comparison and future growth

preserves.behavior: Cohorts are merged only after semantic equivalence is documented; display aliases alone never authorize ranking aggregation.
Metric direction, ranking eligibility, speedup denominators, and query-coverage gates remain fail-closed.
Older snapshots fail with the existing version-remediation path if the read-model shape changes.
Raw submitted benchmark slug, test_type, query evidence, trust label, and result identity remain available for audit.
The UI never presents 15 eligible rows as broad database-market coverage without an explicit preview/coverage qualification.

prior_art.concept: Replace ad-hoc detail.test_type-or-power cohort construction with the agreed canonical identity function.
Make the hosted comparison contract authoritative for whether phase is identity or an annotated mismatch.
Align frontend comparability with the same generated identity fields used by ranking.
Reuse display aliases only for presentation; do not treat them as the data canonicalizer.
